assets.title: Vollmer family migration map and data

privacy.rule: Exclude people explicitly marked living and people with no death record whose latest parsed birth year is within 100 years of generation.

scope.rule: The migration view covers Fredric's maternal and paternal components only; spouse-connected ancestry remains in the canonical tree.

assets.interpretation: Movement records connect birth/death or parent/child birth endpoints as analytical inferences. They are not documented travel routes and are not independent genealogical evidence.
assets.update_policy: Rebuild and validate after any canonical change affecting people, families, dates, places, privacy status, or source references.

assets.title: Person-photo coverage and preserved evidence-media catalog

counts.policy: Use only verified person images; preserve living-person privacy; retain external or rights-restricted photos as links rather than copied files; attach evidence through explicit person mappings and retain exclusions as controls.

assets.interpretation: Portrait status records verified availability, not likeness inference. Evidence mappings are explicit; excluded identity controls remain visibly marked and do not alter relationships.
